faq.a: Abdaal is associated with the Arabic form أَبْدَال, whose core sense is abdaal; substitutes, saints (plural).

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdaal?
faq.a: Abdaal is associated with Arabic. Abdaal is Arabic أَبْدَال (Abdāl), the plural of بَدَل, used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form أَبْدَال is Arabic.
Abdaal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdaal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Abdāl is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdaal mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdaal is rendered ابدال and carries the sense ابدال، نیک لوگ.

faq.q: What does Abdaal mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdaal is rendered ابدال and carries the sense ابدال، اولیا.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-daal. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Abdaal?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdaal, abdaal, abdal. Script forms are أَبْدَال, ابدال, अब्दाल.

faq.q: Is Abdaal a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
